entries.title: Part fan speed steps
entries.note: Revised 2,000 ms/stage F02 operator accepted 2026-10-16. Historical acceptance and inconclusive attempt preserved. Current electronic restore readback not reported; RPM not measured.

acceptance.observation: Operator explicitly accepted revised F02 fan speed stages at 2,000 ms per stage. Latest controller readback and restore verification not separately reported.

previous_acceptances.observation: All three fan-speed steps were observed and LCD reported PASSED_USER; 800 ms per step was judged too brief to distinguish comfortably.
previous_acceptances.note: Acceptance applies only to the original 800 ms-per-step version. Longer 2,000 ms-per-step revision requires user retest.

previous_attempts.observation: The three commanded fan-speed stages physically ran, but LCD showed INCONCLUSIVE without requesting the operator Yes/No observation. No successful electronic restore readback or operator acceptance can be inferred.
previous_attempts.suspected_cause: MoonrakerClient default 5-second HTTP timeout is shorter than the six-second G4 dwell sequence; diagnosis from source code, not yet confirmed by Pi logs.

entries.note: Synchronized O04 red-green-blue-white sequence operator accepted 2026-10-16. Historical blocked and missing blue attempts preserved. Current electronic restore readback not reported.

previous_attempts.observation: O04 was discovered but preflight rejected Happy Hare live status enabled='True' and animation='True' (literal strings). No physical actuation during blocked attempt.
previous_attempts.resolution: Strict boolean/string normalization in shared O04 preflight and controller readback requires signed-head CI and physical retest.

previous_attempts.observation: The Happy Hare-managed O04 test ran after boolean-string support, but user observed red -> green -> white only; blue stage was not visible. Four-color physical acceptance is NOT established.
previous_attempts.resolution: G4 alone is not a guaranteed host/reactor wall-time barrier. Add G4 P650 + M400 after each timed MMU_SET_LED frame; keep O04 pending physical retest.

previous_acceptances.observation: Four Happy Hare LEDs showed red, blue, green, white; original LED policy resumed
